howToUse: For prototyping only — use only when no real data source backed by an actual database table is available yet (e.g. mocking up a screen before its b1_entity/table exists). Backed by a clob payload (referenced by the `data` attribute) holding a JSON array; the appserver's ClobController applies filtering, sorting and pagination server-side (the DSO is addressed by its own name and the appserver resolves it to its payload, like the other DSO types). The `serverType` attribute selects which appserver serves it: `"app"` (the default) routes to the customer appserver (`/service/app/data/clob/<name>`), `"swat"` routes to the framework appserver (`/service/swat/data/clob/<name>`). The customer appserver (the default `"app"`) is what lets a temporary DSO run a customer-side `serverEventsHandler`; use `"swat"` for framework-shipped fixtures. Good for dropdown sources, demo data, and placeholder fixtures — NOT for production data. json sources are writable (create/update/delete persist server-side, keyed by the DSO's keyFields). Replace with a real table/entity-backed data source (b1_data_source_embedded over a b1_entity, or b1_data_source_connector/scl) before production. The backing attribute is `data` — a `dataType: "clob"` attribute holding the payload's `clob_guid`, NOT a URL, path or object name (it replaced the former `dataObject`, which named a separate b1_clob object). The easiest way to create the payload + DSO together is create_data_layer with dataMode:"clob" (pass the rows via sampleRows). For a master-detail JOIN (a master grid whose selection filters this DSO as the detail), set `foreignFields: "<childKey>,<parentKey>"` and a Join link from the master DSO — the join filter is evaluated server-side and matches `eq`/`neq` across number/string; see the `master-detail-join.md` knowledge doc.
label: Temporary Data Source
objectTypeDescription: Data source backed by a clob payload (referenced by `data`) holding a JSON array (read + json CRUD), filtered/sorted server-side.
